start.title: Anza hapa
start.tagline: Kwa nini bustani ni muhimu, na jinsi Park in a Truck inavyofanya kazi.

acquire.title: Pata kiwanja
acquire.tagline: Tafuta kiwanja na upate ruhusa ya kukitumia.
acquire.assumes: Umeshasoma mwongozo, na bado huna kiwanja unachoweza kutumia.

organize.title: Jipange
organize.tagline: Unda kamati ya bustani na uwakusanye majirani zako.

assess.title: Kagua
assess.tagline: Kijue kiwanja chako: jua, udongo na mazingira yake.

dream.title: Ota ndoto
dream.tagline: Buni bustani yako kwa vipande vya bustani.

create.title: Jenga
create.tagline: Ijenge kwa awamu, wikendi moja baada ya nyingine.

sustain.title: Tunza
sustain.tagline: Itunze bustani yako, msimu baada ya msimu.
